name: Pre-Popped Bubble Wrap
tagline: Quiet packaging, for people who post things.
summary: Bubble wrap with every bubble already popped. A roll 30 cm wide and 3 m long. £14.
concept: Bubble wrap that is already popped. It still wraps, cushions and fills a gap. It just doesn't make a sound.
why_it_exists: Packing a parcel next to someone on a call is awkward. This is packaging you can use in silence.
target_customer: People who post things, in shared offices, flats and spare rooms.

physical.form: Flat polyethylene film with a regular grid of 10 mm bubbles, all already flattened. Sold as a 3 m roll.
physical.dimensions: Roll: 300 mm wide x 3 m long. Sheet: A4.

features: Every bubble is already popped, so it is completely quiet to use.
It still wraps and cushions things, because the soft layer of film is still there.
The roll is 30 cm wide and 3 m long, which is plenty for a few parcels.
It is made for people who post things and want packaging that makes no noise.
It is a flat film that is easy to cut, wrap and tape.
arrives: The roll comes in a brown card sleeve with no extra plastic. The parcel is a plain flat box, so you can use the sleeve again to store the roll.
specs: Roll: 30 cm wide x 3 m long. Sheet: A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
Polyethylene bubble film on a cardboard core (Roll only)
3 m on a pink card core
Film: check your local plastic film collection. Core: card recycling.
Store flat or rolled, away from heat
how_it_works: Wrap the item, tape the film shut and put it in a box. Add card or crumpled paper too.
in_the_box: One roll, 30 cm x 3 m, on a card core

compatibility.note: Ice by Post travels in its own insulated box. Do not wrap chilled items in film.
The sandwich travels in a rigid case. Do not wrap it in film.
Fine as a soft outer layer round glass before posting. Pad the box too.

packaging: The Roll comes in a card sleeve. No extra plastic.

warranty.summary: It has a 12-month warranty against faults in how it was made. Creasing is wear, not a fault. See Warranty.

care: Store flat or rolled, away from heat.
Reuse the film until it tears.
Check local plastic film collection before recycling.
safety: It is plastic film. Keep it away from babies and young children.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days if it is unused and in its box. See Returns.

page.headline: Bubble wrap that is already popped
page.intro: Quiet packaging, for people who post things.

sections.title: Already popped
sections.body: Every bubble is flat before it reaches you. It wraps softly and makes no noise.

sections.title: The roll
sections.body: 30 cm wide and 3 m long, £14. Cut it to the size you need.

sections.title: Not a crush-proof wrap
sections.body: It is a soft layer, so use a sturdy box and padding for fragile things.

faq.a: Yes. Nothing is left to pop.
A little. It is a soft layer, so pad the box too.
It is polyethylene film. Check whether your local plastic film collection takes it.
Yes, within 30 days, if it is unused and in its packaging.

troubleshooting.problem: The film will not stay shut.
steps: Tape across the seam, not along it.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Contact support with your order number.

steps: Fold the torn edge in and tape it.
Add another layer over the tear.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: If it arrived torn, contact support with a photo.

photography_direction: A loose roll in off-white, with sky-blue and pink accents, on a pale backdrop. Show texture. No hands.
